bodyHtml:
Happy Year of the Dragon!

As we step into the auspicious Year of the Dragon, Aquasky want to send you our warmest wishes. May your year be filled with happiness, health, and tons of success. And, of course, we're here to keep bringing you the best pressure tanks and services all through 2024.

Understanding the Year of the Dragon

The Year of the Dragon, a symbol of strength, good fortune, and vitality in Chinese culture, is one of the most revered years in the Chinese Zodiac. Dragons are these cool, mythical creatures representing power and wisdom. People born in the Dragon year are seen as someone who’s ambitious, confident, and capable of great achievements.

And let me tell you, this year is looking like it's going to be full of great possibilities and achievements.

Aquasky’s Holiday Schedule for 2024

Our offices will be closed for the Chinese New Year Holiday from Feb. 8th to Feb. 15th, 2024.

We will be back to our regular office hours on Feb. 16th, 2024.

We appreciate your understanding and support as our team takes this time to celebrate with their families and loved ones. May the Year of the Dragon bring you immense joy, health, and success!
